vehicles.description: Tesla's best-selling compact sedan with industry-leading range and the latest Autopilot driver assistance system.
The quickest production car ever made, combining supercar acceleration with over 390 miles of real-world range.
Holds the world record for EV range, featuring luxury appointments and Lucid's proprietary Wunderbox charging technology.
BMW's electric performance sedan delivering M-badge driving dynamics with the practicality of a Gran Coupé.
Scandinavian minimalist design meets electrified performance, built on Volvo's platform with a Google-powered infotainment system.
A grand tourer built on Porsche's J1 platform, blending Bauhaus design with Audi's legendary quattro all-wheel drive.
Porsche's first all-electric sports car, featuring 800V architecture for ultra-fast charging and iconic sports car handling.
The pinnacle of EV luxury, featuring a 56-inch Hyperscreen, the lowest drag coefficient of any production car, and whisper-quiet cabin.
Award-winning aerodynamic sedan with a drag coefficient of just 0.21 Cd, built on 800V architecture for 18-minute fast charging.
BYD's flagship electric sedan featuring Blade Battery technology and is available in both China and international markets.
NIO's flagship sedan with an innovative battery-as-a-service model, offering swappable battery packs for near-instant recharging.
Xpeng's sporty electric sedan with XPILOT 3.5 driver assistance and a sleek fastback design.
The world's best-selling car in 2023, combining SUV practicality with Tesla's Supercharger network and Autopilot technology.
The world's quickest SUV with tri-motor Plaid powertrain, falcon-wing rear doors, and seating for up to seven.
An adventure-focused electric SUV with class-leading off-road capability, 14.4 inches of ground clearance, and camp mode features.
Ford's iconic Mustang nameplate goes electric, delivering pony car styling with crossover practicality and BlueCruise hands-free driving.
World Car of the Year 2022, with retro-futurist pixel-inspired design, a flat floor for maximum interior space, and ultra-fast 800V charging.
Kia's high-performance electric crossover with 800V architecture enabling 350kW DC fast charging and 577 hp from dual motors.
Volkswagen's global electric crossover built on the modular MEB platform, manufactured across Germany, USA, and China.
BMW's technology flagship featuring a carbon fiber passenger cell, self-healing kidney grille, and 5G connectivity.
The evolution of Audi's e-tron flagship, with a larger battery, increased range, and refined quattro electric all-wheel drive.
Cadillac's first fully electric vehicle, featuring a 33-inch pillar-to-pillar LED display and GM's Ultium battery platform.
Volvo's safest car ever, featuring LIDAR sensors, a solid-state battery-ready platform, and seven-seat sustainable interior.
BYD's global compact SUV featuring Blade Battery technology for improved safety, available in Europe, Australia, and Asia-Pacific markets.
Tesla's stainless steel electric pickup with exoskeleton body, adaptive air suspension, and vault-like storage bed.
America's first mass-produced electric pickup, with a gear tunnel, lockable front trunk, and off-road capability for true adventure.
America's best-selling truck goes electric, with 9.6kW onboard power export to run tools and appliances at work or during outages.
The supertruck reinvented — with 1,000 hp, Crab Mode for diagonal movement, and Extract Mode lifting the body for extreme off-roading.
GM's Ultium-powered Silverado EV offers the longest range of any electric truck with a massive 10.2kW bidirectional charging capability.
The most powerful Taycan ever made, setting a Nürburgring EV lap record with 1,093 hp and performance tires developed with Pirelli.
The world's fastest production car, with four independent electric motors producing 1,914 hp and a verified 1.85-second 0–60 mph time.
Lotus's first-ever SUV is a high-performance electric hyper-SUV with active aerodynamics and LIDAR sensors for advanced driver assistance.
The next-generation Roadster promises to be the fastest production car on Earth with optional SpaceX cold air rocket thruster package.
Japan's ultra-low electric hypercar produced in a limited run of 50 units, built entirely from carbon fiber with four independent motors.
Italy's most powerful road car ever, hand-built in Turin with 1,877 hp from four motors on Rimac's technology platform.
Zero's flagship naked electric streetfighter with a Bosch Motorcycle Stability Control system and seamless torque delivery from 0 rpm.
Harley-Davidson's purpose-built electric motorcycle brand, engineered for urban riding with a connected app and over-the-air updates.
Europe's first touring electric motorcycle with the longest range in its class, CCS DC fast charging, and comprehensive luggage options.
The world's fastest production motorcycle, achieving 218 mph at Bonneville Salt Flats with a carbon fiber monocoque chassis.
An affordable urban electric motorcycle with retro café racer styling and a removable battery for convenient charging anywhere.
The iconic VW Microbus reborn as a zero-emission family van, available in short and long-wheelbase versions with up to seven seats.
Mercedes-Benz's best-selling cargo van goes electric with three battery options, offering fleet operators zero-emission last-mile delivery.
Ford's Transit goes electric with 2,205 lbs of payload capacity, Pro Power Onboard, and Ford Pro telematics for fleet management.
BYD's lightweight electric delivery van, widely adopted by logistics companies and ride-hailing fleets across Asia and Europe.
Designed exclusively for Amazon's delivery fleet, the Rivian EDV 700 features an ergonomic driver workspace and advanced safety systems.
The world's most-deployed electric bus, with over 70,000 units operating across 300+ cities in 50+ countries worldwide.
Yutong's flagship electric city bus, the world's top-selling e-bus brand, with advanced energy management and real-time fleet telematics.
America's leading electric transit bus with the longest range of any battery-electric bus, manufactured in Burlingame, California.
North America's most widely deployed heavy-duty transit bus platform, with Xcelsior Charge serving transit agencies across the US and Canada.
BYD's double-decker electric coach, operating in cities including London and Singapore, replacing diesel-powered tourist and inter-city coaches.
Kia's first three‑row electric SUV offering up to 300 miles of range and a spacious interior.
Nissan's crossover with all‑wheel‑drive e‑4ORCE system and up to 280 miles of EPA range.
Toyota's first dedicated EV SUV, featuring a 71 kWh battery and optional dual‑motor AWD.
Fisker's premium electric SUV with a 115 kWh pack, 0‑60 in 3.1 s and a solar‑roof option.
Chevrolet's compact crossover with a 65 kWh battery and Super Cruise hands‑free driving.
BMW's entry‑level electric SUV, sharing the iX platform and offering up to 260 miles of range.
Mercedes' midsize electric sedan, positioned between the EQS and EQB, with a 90 kWh pack.
BYD's compact electric sedan for the Chinese market, offering a modest 210‑mile range.
Renault's new electric compact sedan, replacing the Zoe with a larger battery and more space.
BMW's first fully electric midsize sedan, offering a spacious interior and balanced performance.
Compact electric SUV that fits three rows of seats, built on the same platform as the EQC.
VW's flagship electric sedan, positioned between the ID.4 and the ID. Buzz, with a spacious interior and advanced driver assistance.
All‑electric version of Ford's popular midsize SUV, offering three rows and a large usable cargo area.
Tesla's electric class‑8 truck designed for long‑haul freight, featuring a 150 kWh battery pack and aerodynamic design.
More affordable sibling to the R1S, the R2 offers a compact footprint with Rivian's adventure‑ready features.
BYD's sleek, high‑performance sedan aimed at the global market, competing with Tesla Model 3.
Lucid's first electric SUV, delivering luxury, long range, and performance comparable to the Air sedan.
Kia's three‑row electric SUV, offering a spacious interior and a competitive range for families.
BMW's flagship luxury electric sedan offering a spacious interior and advanced driver assistance.
A midsize electric SUV that blends Mercedes luxury with a practical electric drivetrain.
VW's sleek coupe‑style EV built on the MEB platform, offering a balance of range and style.
Compact city EV with retro styling, ideal for urban commuting.
The long‑standing Leaf receives a larger battery and updated tech for a modern EV experience.
Polestar's first SUV, combining Scandinavian design with strong performance and a 300‑mile range.
A compact three‑row SUV that slots between the EV6 and the larger EV9, offering versatile interior space.
Volvo's electric heavy‑duty truck designed for urban distribution with a robust 120 kWh battery.
Proterra's latest high‑capacity transit bus with modular battery packs and fast‑charge capability.
Fisker's affordable compact SUV aimed at the mass market, featuring a solar roof and sustainable materials.
Hyundai's flagship three‑row electric SUV offering spacious seating and a 92 kWh battery.
Kia's large electric SUV positioned above the EV6, with a high‑capacity battery and premium interior.
Mazda's compact crossover EV with distinctive freestyle doors and a focus on sustainable materials.
Honda's first dedicated EV SUV, built on a new e‑architecture platform with a 77 kWh pack.
All‑electric version of Nissan's iconic Z sports car, delivering 400 hp and a 0‑60 time of 3 seconds.
Compact electric SUV slotting below the iX, featuring a 71 kWh battery and BMW's latest infotainment system.
Volkswagen's affordable entry‑level electric hatchback, aimed at European city markets.
Leapmotor's flagship three‑row electric SUV, offering a 100 kWh pack and advanced driver‑assist features.
